description: This file manages page tabbing modifications in Drupal, providing an API for constraining and releasing focus on specific page elements, handling focus trapping, and managing tabbing contexts and their stack.

classes.name: Drupal~TabbingManager
classes.description: Class managing a stack of tabbing contexts, constraining tab order, and focus trapping.

classes.name: Drupal~TabbingContext
classes.description: Class representing a set of tabbable elements with methods to activate, deactivate, and release focus constraints.

methods.name: constrain
methods.description: Constrains tabbing to a specific set of elements, optionally trapping focus within them.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the current tabbing context, restoring previous focus constraints.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a tabbing context, making its elements tabbable and trapping focus if specified.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a tabbing context, restoring the previous tabbable state.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the tabbing context, deactivating it and removing focus constraints.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the tabbing context, making its elements focusable.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the tabbing context, restoring previous focus state.
